source: tingqr rule (bank lookup folds ASCII letters only), Plan 8a final review
note: U+0130 (LATIN CAPITAL LETTER I WITH DOT ABOVE) is not an ASCII letter, so it is compared as it is and VİB matches no code or short name (VIB is 970441). Only A-Z fold, because codes and short names are ASCII and full Unicode lower-casing differs between languages: JavaScript toLowerCase gives vi̇b (i + U+0307), .NET 10 ToLowerInvariant leaves U+0130 unchanged (both checked 2026-11-22). Both full foldings happen to miss here; the vector pins the ASCII-only rule.
